Below is a 12-week strength program tailored to her menstrual cycle and the two acyclic flare windows, starting Monday 2026-06-01. Structure phases intensity and exercise selection to leverage higher-tolerance windows and downshift during flow/flare. Assumes 4 sessions/week (A/B split), with built‑in deloads around menses/flare, and progressive overload elsewhere.

Key constraints applied throughout
- On flow days (menstruation) and on flare days (2026-07-10 to 2026-07-13; 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07): no HIIT, no heavy Valsalva, no jumping. Use submax loads, more machine/DB work, tempo control, and breathing cueing.
- Outside those windows: cleared for progressive barbell and accessory strength.
- Cycle map (27-day cycle; LMP 2026-05-04):
  - Periods expected: 2026-05-04 (baseline), 2026-05-31 to 06-03/04; 2026-06-27/28 to ~07-01; 2026-07-24/25 to ~07-28; 2026-08-20/21 to ~08-24.
  - We’ll program lighter/deload sessions on those windows.
- Weekly layout: Mon (Session A1 lower emphasis), Tue (B1 upper), Thu (A2 lower), Sat (B2 upper). Swap days in a week as needed to match symptoms; on flow/flare, choose that week’s “Low” versions.

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1-3, 06-01 to 06-21): Technique consolidation, moderate volume, linear load build.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 4-6, 06-22 to 07-12): Strength emphasis, top sets + back-off volume. Deload around end-June menses and protect 07-10 to 07-13 flare.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 7-9, 07-13 to 08-02): Resume progression post-flare; heaviest block with careful RPE caps.
- Phase 4 (Weeks 10-12, 08-03 to 08-24): Manage second flare (08-04 to 08-07) and late-Aug menses with a taper + strength skill maintenance.

RPE and breathing
- Use RPE 6-9 guidance. No sustained Valsalva on flow/flare days; exhale through sticking point, brace gently on inhale.
- On non-restricted days, natural bracing allowed but avoid maximal grinding (>RPE 9).

Warm-up (each session)
- 5-8 min low-impact cyc/row/track walk
- Mobility: 1-2 sets x 8-10 reps each: 90/90 hip switches, cat-cow, thoracic rotations, band dislocates
- Activation: glute bridge 2x12, dead bug 2x8/side (slow), scap push-up 2x10

Cool-down
- 5 min easy walk/bike + diaphragmatic breathing 3-5 min (4-6s inhale, 6-8s exhale), gentle hip flexor, adductor, piriformis stretches

Progression rules
- If all prescribed sets hit at target RPE and good form, add 2-2.5 kg upper, 2.5-5 kg lower next week; or 1 rep per set within ranges. On flow/flare weeks, hold or reduce 5-10%.
- If cramps/fatigue spike any day, switch to that day’s Low option (provided).

Week-by-week

Week 1 (Mon 06-01 to Sun 06-07) — Late-period days likely 05-31 to 06-03/04
- Expect flow Mon-Tue. Use Low versions on those days.
- Session A1 (Mon) Low if flow:
  - Goblet squat 3x8 RPE 6-7
  - Trap bar deadlift 3x6 RPE 7 (light), controlled
  - Split squat (rear-foot elevated optional) 3x8/side RPE 6-7
  - Standing calf raise 3x12
  - Core: Side plank 3x25-35s/side, Dead bug 2x8/side
- Session B1 (Tue) Low if flow:
  - DB flat press 3x8 RPE 7
  - 1-arm chest-supported row 3x10/arm
  - Half-kneeling 1-arm landmine press or DB press 3x8/arm
  - Lat pulldown (medium grip) 3x10
  - Face pull 2x12, Pallof press 2x10/side
- Session A2 (Thu) Normal:
  - Back squat 4x6 RPE 7-8
  - RDL 3x8 RPE 7
  - Walking lunge 3x10/leg
  - Hip thrust 3x8 RPE 7
  - Copenhagen plank (knees) 2x20-30s/side
- Session B2 (Sat) Normal:
  - Bench press 4x6 RPE 7-8
  - Chest-supported row 4x8
  - Overhead press 3x6-8 RPE 7
  - Pull-up or assisted 3xAMRAP @ RPE 8-9 stop 1-2 reps in reserve
  - DB incline curl 2x12, Rope pressdown 2x12

Week 2 (06-08 to 06-14)
- Progress 2-5%. All Normal.
- A1:
  - Back squat 4x5 RPE 7.5
  - Trap bar deadlift 4x5 RPE 7.5
  - Split squat 3x8/leg slightly heavier
  - Hip thrust 3x8 RPE 7.5
  - Core: Stir-the-pot 3x8-10 circles/dir
- B1:
  - Bench press 4x5 RPE 7.5
  - Pendlay row or barbell row 4x6
  - Seated DB OHP 3x8
  - Lat pulldown 3x8-10
  - Rear delt fly 2x15, Cable chop 2x10/side
- A2:
  - Front squat or safety bar squat 3x5 RPE 7
  - Romanian deadlift 3x6-8 RPE 7.5
  - Step-up (knee height) 3x8/leg
  - Seated calf raise 3x12-15
  - Side plank with abduction 2x20-30s/side
- B2:
  - Close-grip bench 3x6-8
  - Chest-supported row 3x8
  - Landmine press 3x6-8/arm
  - Neutral-grip pull-up or assisted 3xAMRAP
  - Hammer curl 2x12, Overhead rope extension 2x12

Week 3 (06-15 to 06-21)
- Heaviest so far, still submax.
- A1:
  - Back squat 5x4 RPE 8
  - Deadlift (conventional or trap) 4x4 RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 4x6 RPE 8
  - Reverse lunge 3x8/leg
  - Core: Weighted plank 3x30-40s
- B1:
  - Bench press 5x4 RPE 8
  - Barbell row 4x6
  - Standing OHP 4x4-6 RPE 8
  - Pull-up 4xAMRAP stop 1 rep shy
  - Accessory arms 2x10-12 each
- A2:
  - Front squat 4x4 RPE 7.5-8
  - RDL 4x6 RPE 8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x8/leg
  - Calf raise 3x12-15
  - Copenhagen plank 2x25-35s
- B2:
  - Bench (pause 1s) 4x3-4 RPE 8
  - Single-arm row 3x8-10/arm
  - DB incline press 3x8
  - Wide-grip pulldown 3x8-10
  - Face pull 3x12-15

Week 4 (06-22 to 06-28) — Deload starts near menses (expected 06-27/28)
- Mon-Thu normal-to-moderate; reduce load/volume Fri-Sat if flow begins.
- A1:
  - Back squat 3x5 at ~80% of Week 3 load (RPE 6-7)
  - Trap bar deadlift 3x5 light-moderate
  - Split squat 2x8/leg
  - Hip thrust 2x8
  - Side plank 2x25s
- B1:
  - Bench press 3x5 @ ~80% W3
  - Chest-supported row 3x8 light
  - Seated DB OHP 2x8
  - Lat pulldown 2x10
  - Face pull 2x12
- A2 (if flow Fri): Low
  - Goblet squat 3x8 RPE 6
  - KB RDL 3x10 light
  - Step-up 2x10/leg
  - Calf raise 2x12
  - Breathing core: 90-90 hip lift 2x6 breaths
- B2 (Sat) Low if flow:
  - DB press 3x8 light
  - Row 3x10 light
  - Landmine or DB press 2x8
  - Band pulldown 2x12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side

Week 5 (06-29 to 07-05) — Early period days continue into midweek
- Keep Low until flow subsides, then ramp.
- A1 (Mon) Low if still flow:
  - Goblet squat 3x10 RPE 6-7
  - Hip thrust 3x10 light
  - Reverse lunge 3x8/leg
  - Core: Dead bug 2x8/side
- B1 (Tue) Low if flow:
  - DB bench 3x10
  - Chest-supported row 3x10
  - Seated DB OHP 2x10
  - Lat pulldown 2x12
- A2 (Thu) Normal:
  - Back squat 4x5 RPE 7.5
  - Deadlift 4x4 RPE 7.5
  - Hip thrust 3x6-8 RPE 7.5
  - Split squat 3x8/leg
- B2 (Sat) Normal:
  - Bench press 4x5 RPE 7.5
  - Barbell row 4x6
  - OHP 3x6-8
  - Pull-ups 3-4xAMRAP

Week 6 (07-06 to 07-12) — Strength build but protect 07-10 to 07-13 flare
- Front-load heavier work early; 07-10 to 07-12 use Low variants.
- A1 (Mon):
  - Back squat 5x3 RPE 8
  - Deadlift 4x3 RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 4x5 RPE 8
  - Walking lunge 3x8/leg
- B1 (Tue):
  - Bench press 5x3 RPE 8
  - Barbell row 4x5-6
  - Standing OHP 4x3-5 RPE 8
  - Pull-up 4xAMRAP stop 1 shy
- A2 (Thu 07-09):
  - Lighter: Safety bar or front squat 3x4 RPE 7
  - RDL 3x6 RPE 7
  - Step-up 2x8/leg
- B2 (Sat 07-11) Low (flare):
  - DB bench 3x8 light-moderate RPE 6-7
  - Chest-supported row 3x10
  - Seated DB press 2x8
  - Band pulldown 2x12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side
- If training Sun 07-12, also Low or rest.

Week 7 (07-13 to 07-19) — Post-flare resume
- A1:
  - Back squat 4x4 RPE 7.5-8
  - Deadlift 4x4 RPE 7.5-8
  - Hip thrust 3x6-8 RPE 8
  - Reverse lunge 3x8/leg
- B1:
  - Bench 4x4 RPE 8
  - Barbell row 4x6
  - OHP 3x5-6 RPE 7.5-8
  - Pull-ups 4xAMRAP
- A2:
  - Front squat 3x4 RPE 7.5
  - RDL 3x6-8
  - Bulgarian split squat 3x8/leg
- B2:
  - Paused bench 4x3-4 RPE 8
  - Single-arm row 3x8-10
  - DB incline press 3x8
  - Wide pulldown 3x8-10

Week 8 (07-20 to 07-26) — Peak strength, watch for menses ~07-24/25
- Early week heavier; Low option Fri/Sat if period starts.
- A1 (Mon):
  - Back squat Top set x1-2 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ 90% of that
  - Deadlift 4x3 RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 3x5-6 RPE 8-8.5
- B1 (Tue):
  - Bench Top set x1-2 @ RPE 8, then 3x3 @ 90%
  - Barbell row 4x5-6
  - OHP 3x3-5 RPE 8
- A2 (Thu):
  - Front squat 3x3 RPE 8
  - RDL 3x5-6 RPE 8
  - Split squat 3x8/leg
- B2 (Sat) Low if flow:
  - DB press 3x8
  - Row 3x10
  - Seated DB OHP 2x8
  - Band pulldown 2x12
  - Core gentle breathing 2x6 breaths

Week 9 (07-27 to 08-02) — Post-menses consolidation
- Slight step back in volume, hold intensity submax.
- A1:
  - Back squat 4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Deadlift 4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Hip thrust 3x5-6
- B1:
  - Bench 4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Barbell row 4x5
  - OHP 3x4-5
- A2:
  - Front squat 3x3 RPE 7.5
  - RDL 3x5-6
  - Lunge 2-3x8/leg
- B2:
  - Paused bench 3x3-4
  - Pull-up 4xAMRAP
  - Accessory arms/shoulders 2x12 each

Week 10 (08-03 to 08-09) — Manage flare 08-04 to 08-07
- Heavier session Mon, then Low during flare, resume Sun if desired.
- A1 (Mon 08-03):
  - Back squat 4x3 RPE 8
  - Deadlift 3x3 RPE 8
  - Hip thrust 3x5-6 RPE 8
- B1 (Tue 08-04) Low (flare):
  - DB bench 3x8 RPE 6-7
  - Chest-supported row 3x10
  - Seated DB press 2x8
  - Lat pulldown 2x12
- A2 (Thu 08-06) Low (flare):
  - Goblet squat 3x8
  - KB RDL 3x10
  - Step-up 2x10/leg
  - Core: Dead bug 2x8/side
- B2 (Sat 08-08) Low or Rest (flare ends 08-07; use Low if residual):
  - DB press 3x8
  - Row 3x10
  - Band pulldown 2x12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side

Week 11 (08-10 to 08-16) — Rebuild after flare
- A1:
  - Back squat 4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Deadlift 3-4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Hip thrust 3x5-6
- B1:
  - Bench 4x3 RPE 7.5-8
  - Row 4x5
  - OHP 3x4-5
- A2:
  - Front squat 3x3 RPE 7.5
  - RDL 3x5-6
  - Bulgarian split squat 2-3x8/leg
- B2:
  - Paused bench 3x3-4
  - Pull-up 4xAMRAP
  - Accessory 2x12

Week 12 (08-17 to 08-24) — Taper around expected period ~08-20/21
- Early week light-to-moderate; Low options if flow starts.
- A1:
  - Back squat 3x3 @ ~80% of Week 11 load (RPE 6-7)
  - Deadlift 3x3 light-moderate
  - Hip thrust 2x5-6 easy
- B1:
  - Bench 3x3 @ ~80% W11
  - Row 3x6 light
  - OHP 2x4-5 easy
- A2 (Thu) Low if flow:
  - Goblet squat 3x8
  - KB RDL 3x10
  - Step-up 2x10/leg
- B2 (Sat) Low if flow:
  - DB press 3x8
  - Row 3x10
  - Band pulldown 2x12
  - Pallof press 2x10/side
- Optional testing the following week if symptom window clear.

Recovery and symptom-aware adjustments
- Autoregulation:
  - On any day with pelvic pain, bloating, or deep fatigue, drop load 5-15%, shorten sets to the low end, extend rest, or switch to Low session.
  - Prefer machine/DB substitutions on symptomatic days to reduce bracing demand: e.g., leg press for squats, cable rows for barbell rows.
- Rest between sets:
  - Main lifts 2-3 min (heavier weeks up to 4); accessories 60-90s. On flow/flare, keep rests generous and avoid breath-holding.
- Sleep: 7.5-9 h. During flow/flare aim for upper end; short naps acceptable.
- Non-training days: 20-30 min easy walks, gentle mobility. Avoid impact and intense core compression during flares.

Nutrition notes (general, align with symptoms)
- Protein: 1.6-2.2 g/kg/day spread across 3-5 meals.
- Carbs: Anchor around training (25-40 g pre; 30-60 g post). During luteal and flares, cravings may rise—pre-plan fiber-rich carbs and hydration to stabilize energy.
- Fats: 0.8-1.0 g/kg/day, emphasize omega-3s (fish 2-3x/week or 1-2 g EPA/DHA if approved by her physician), olive oil, nuts/seeds.
- Anti-inflammatory emphasis: Colorful veg/fruit, turmeric/ginger in meals if tolerated.
- Hydration: 30-40 ml/kg/day; add electrolytes if crampy/sweaty.
- Caffeine timing: Useful pre-luteal fatigue but may worsen cramps/GI in some; assess response.

Pelvic floor and bracing cues
- On flow/flare: gentle 360° breath, engage pelvic floor 20-30% on exhale; avoid maximal straining. Use tempo 3-1-1 for main lifts to keep control.
- If any pelvic heaviness/pressure, regress load or move to machines and shorten ROM pain-free.

Readiness checklist weekly
- Rate pain, fatigue, sleep, stress (1-5). If two or more are ≥4, use Low variant that day or shift the heavy day later in the week.

Notes for you, the trainer
- This plan purposefully clusters heavier exposures in the mid-follicular and mid-luteal non-flare days, and uses Low/deload templates around: 06-27/28 to ~07-01, 07-10 to 07-13, 07-24/25 to ~07-28, and 08-20/21 to ~08-24, plus 08-04 to 08-07 flare.
- If her actual period dates shift, slide the Low sessions to match symptoms and keep total weekly sets for main patterns within:
  - Squat pattern: 8-12 hard sets/week outside Low weeks; 4-6 sets on Low/deload weeks
  - Hinge pattern: 6-10 vs 3-5
  - Horizontal press/pull: 8-12 vs 4-6
  - Vertical press/pull: 6-10 vs 3-5

Exercise substitutions (if needed)
- Squat: back squat → safety bar → goblet → leg press
- Hinge: barbell deadlift → trap bar → RDL → cable pull-through
- Press: barbell bench → DB bench → machine chest press
- Row: barbell row → chest-supported row → cable row
- OHP: barbell → seated DB → machine shoulder press

This schedule should keep her progressing while respecting both menstrual and acyclic flare windows. Adjust loads via RPE and feel free to rearrange within each week to match exact symptom days.
